paper: FinCon: A Synthesized LLM Multi-Agent System with Conceptual Verbal Reinforcement for Enhanced Financial Decision Making
headline_strategy: GPT-4-Turbo manager/analyst hierarchy that distills multimodal news, filings, earnings-call audio, research and market data into long/short/neutral decisions, updates beliefs through conceptual verbal reinforcement, applies CVaR risk reflection, and uses direction-constrained mean-variance portfolio weights

paper_configuration.candidate_pool: 42 stocks with more than 800 news articles

paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable because neither the decision policy nor any implementation/data/model artifact is released
missing_headline_objects: FinCon source code, complete prompts, configurations, environment, and tests
frozen multimodal commercial/public inputs and exact 42-stock membership
paper-time GPT-4-Turbo and Whisper snapshots plus sampling and parsing rules
working, procedural, and episodic memory state and decay parameters
CVaR estimator, alert, reflection, and conceptual verbal reinforcement implementation
manager actions, analyst outputs, raw trajectories, beliefs, and checkpoints
the complete direction-constrained mean-variance objective, covariance estimator, solver and bounds
execution timing, position persistence, leverage/short rules and trading frictions

rejected_substitutes.reason: It is a researcher-created M0 CVaR narrative translation and contains none of the manager/analyst, memory, reflection, or CVRF policy.

rejected_substitutes.route: Implement a generic CVaR or mean-variance portfolio
rejected_substitutes.reason: Risk control consumes FinCon decisions; it is not the missing decision policy and the optimizer itself is underspecified.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use InvestorBench or Agent Market Arena code
rejected_substitutes.reason: They are explicitly separate systems and cannot receive FinCon provenance.
The current-response baseline check has no paper-time lineage and published cells/plots are outputs, not a transferable policy.

rejected_substitutes.route: Build a new multi-agent system using JKP characteristics
rejected_substitutes.reason: JKP does not replace the news, filings, audio, analyst research, memories and verbal reinforcement that define FinCon.

result_policy: No M0 CVaR proxy, generic optimizer, adjacent-system code, baseline replay, or invented agent is entered as a FinCon return. The positive paper results remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
